name: Chicken Fire

features.name: Coin collect
features.description: Collectors on reel 2 gather the values of coins on screen.

features.name: Hold and Win jackpots
features.description: Four jackpots, with three bonus buy options.

review:
A five-line classic made with LudexPlay. Coins land on the outer reels, and a Collect symbol on reel 2 adds them up and pays them out when they land together.

Wild chickens fill in lines and can leave multipliers behind, and the Hold and Win bonus has four jackpots shown above the grid. There are three buy options, from a classic bonus at 60x to a high-volatility Super Bonus at 90x. Medium-high volatility, 5,000x max, 95.9% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
